tools.name: search_breaches
tools.description: Find publicly reported data breaches of a company or service by name (any language, e.g. Coupang, 쿠팡, SK Telecom, Ticketmaster, アスクル). Returns up to 5 most recent incidents with date, number affected, leaked data types, compensation and fine flags, a source link and the Teollimi page, plus how many

tools.name: recent_breaches
tools.description: Data breaches announced in the last few days (default 30), newest first, optionally in one country. Returns up to 10 incidents with date, scale, leaked data types, a source link and the Teollimi page.

tools.name: check_services
tools.description: Given up to 10 companies or services a person uses, say for each whether Teollimi has a reported breach, how many, and the latest one with what leaked. Absence of a record does not mean the service was never breached.

tools.name: open_settlements
tools.description: US class action data breach settlements that are still taking claims, soonest deadline first, optionally for one company. Returns up to 5 with claim deadline, maximum payout per person, whether proof is needed, the official claim site and the Teollimi page.

tools.name: breach_response_steps
tools.description: Steps to take after a breach notice, by the kinds of data that leaked (password, card, national ID and so on), with official places to check exposure or get help in Korea, the US and Japan.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "breach_response_steps" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
